html: † פַּקֻּעֹת n.[f.] pl. gourds (wild cucumbers, citrullus colocynthis, with purgative properties, according to PostHastings DB ii. 250 DeRIHWB 278 f. 𝔊 κολοκυνθίς; > momordica (or ecballium) elaterium, which is not a vine; cf. Syriac ܦܰܩܽܘܥܳܐ, fruit of colocynthis (or the similar cucumis prophetarum), Löwl.c. Brock):—cstr. פ׳ שָׂדֶה 2 K 4:39.
